decisions.reason: The electronic church-motif music box extends the firm's established music-box and lighting capabilities, so management can interpret early sales and refine the design in-house, although the electronics component sits slightly further from its core woodcraft knowledge.
A wooden nativity stable lies squarely within the firm's long-built Christmas woodcraft and design knowledge, so it is easy to assimilate and improve and fits its seasonal collector market.

The modern incense smoker builds directly on the firm's traditional figurine expertise and supports its strategy of blending tradition with contemporary design, making it a well-absorbed extension to retain.
